summary: ABB is swedish-Swiss robotics and electrical equipment company, founded in 1988. Type: listed company. About 110,000 employees (Wikidata). Revenue $28.9 billion (2021). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 1 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 7 about acquisitions; 2 about growth or hiring.

culture.text: A very large multinational of about 110,000 employees (2024), working on electrification, robotics and industrial automation.
Describes itself as helping industries run leaner and cleaner, promising people room to lead and grow.

open.text: ABB B.V. is an IND recognised sponsor, so it can sponsor highly skilled migrant visas.
The Dutch entity is owned by ABB Ltd in Switzerland.

growth.text: Reported revenue of USD 28.9 billion and net profit of USD 4.5 billion in 2021.
Is pushing into power for AI data centres, launching its Infinitus DC product range in September 2026.
Its E-Mobility arm took over service of truck-charging infrastructure for ASKO.

worth_knowing.text: Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for industrial AIoT platforms.
